description: Manual Railway Template Composer operator checklist only; not an importable template or deployment.

source.notes: Build and test on PC. Owner must independently approve source and explicitly authorize a manual registry push. Registry returns a real manifest digest, which must be verified against PC-built image provenance before Composer entry. No GitHub-source build.

requiredOwnerVariables.description: Provide a fresh CSPRNG-generated canonical 32-byte base64url secret (43 chars). Save privately. Never enter an example or put the secret in the image.

registryOptions.publicRegistry: Possible after explicit owner approval; ensure image/code contains no secrets and supports public distribution.
registryOptions.privateRegistry: Railway private-registry credentials require Pro plan (verify current Railway billing/policy before paid use).

publicationBlockers: owner approves specific committed PC-tested source SHA
owner approves manual upload to a chosen registry (no upload authorized by T3)
owner captures and independently verifies an immutable registry manifest digest
owner reviews registry visibility, access and Railway plan/billing
owner authorizes private pilot; verify HTTPS domain/TLS and persistent volume
owner separately approves public template publication after pilot
